4-Q_self.journal: I've spent the better part of a day standing beside the hut, and all it bought me is that it's still standing, which I can't say was down to my standing there, since Corvin and Tobin both came near and neither touched it. I said I'd cut stone and then kept guarding anyway, so I still hold 3457024 against the 6660096 a rebuild takes, and that gap is the only thing that matters if the hut goes again. I stared at Corvin from a metre away and never asked why they took the first hut down, so I'm still angry and still don't know the reason, and I don't know what Tobin wanted hanging about either. No more idle watching: I'm going to the stone pile beside the plot now, keeping the hut in sight, I'll ask Corvin straight out if they come near, and the plaza waits until I hold a full hut's worth.

1-Q_place.journal: Corvin tore down the whole hut I built, about half an hour ago, and I haven't forgotten it and don't know why he did it. When I tried to rebuild just now it failed, because the hut takes 6660096 of stone and I'm holding only 1728512, though my limestone, 1064960, covers the 1032192 it needs. So the plot is empty, the shortfall is only stone, and I'm not going to let one man's doing leave my work undone. I'll go to the stone pile and cut stone again, then rebuild the hut, and I'll keep an eye on whether Corvin comes near it again.
